Creator programmesthat scaleat the speed of AI.

Tano runs your creator programme as an iterative loop that continuously improves and scales to your needs. Run thousands of creator partnerships with the care you’d give ten.

01Set by you

Your setup

You choose what the programme is for, which products to gift and the guardrails every creator works within, such as no competitor partnerships and a clear #ad on every post. Everything Tano does next works from this setup, so the programme starts out pointing the way you want.

02Run by Tano

Find your creators

Tano scores thousands of creators on how likely they are to post and sell for you, working from your objective and within your guardrails. Those whose audiences buy through links and who clear every guardrail are shortlisted, so the creators you gift to are the ones most likely to sell.

03Run by Tano

Get them posting

Tano’s agents write to each shortlisted creator personally, drawing on their own posts, then match a gift from your product range and book the delivery. Every message stays within your guardrails, so creators reply to a conversation rather than a template.

04Run by Tano

Learn what works

Tano tests who to recruit, what to say and which incentive to offer, each measured against your objective and your products. The winners scale on their own while the tests keep running, so the programme keeps learning which creators, messages and rewards sell best.

The questionsbuyersactually ask.

Everything on pricing, channels, timeframes, and how we can support you.

  • Tano runs performance-driven creator programmes at scale, from sourcing and vetting to outreach, product gifting, ongoing relationships and performance tracking. We also help you identify creator content to use in paid ads.

  • No. Tano manages the programme for you through its own platform. Your team sets the direction, provides brand feedback and selects content for paid media.

  • Tano is paid on results. It earns when a creator's post goes live, and most of all through a 20% share of the sales those creators drive. Tano carries the upfront risk alongside you: it finds, onboards and sends product to every creator, and if a creator doesn't post, Tano doesn't get paid. The fee per post falls as your programme grows. Programmes start at 100 seeded products a month, which typically comes to about $3,000. Product, shipping, creator commissions, milestone rewards, content rights and media spend should also be included in your budget.

  • Yes. Tano can manage the smaller-creator programme while your team or agency retains responsibility for larger partnerships, PR and media buying.

  • Not necessarily. The programmes can run separately, with creator lists cross-referenced to manage overlap.

  • Tano supports automated gifting through Shopify. If you use another ordering system, compatibility and the fulfilment approach need to be confirmed before launch.
